memo.capex_guidance: No quantitative capex or FX guidance given in the H1 2026 report/press release. Tax: estimated average annual tax rate for FY2026 28% excluding the French exceptional contribution, 33% including it (similar to 2025); contribution renewed for one more year by the 2026 Finance Act at 41.2% rate; H1 ETR 35.4% because the 2025-based portion was booked in full in H1 (IAS 34). FX: currency fluctuations had a negative impact of more than EUR 360m on H1 revenue (-EUR 361m / -4.5 pts per APM note). Segment note: internal-price adjustments, neutral for group operating income, will occur in H2 and mainly affect France and Asia-Pacific (excl. Japan). Medium-term: ambitious goal for revenue growth at constant exchange rates confirmed.

notes: General: all H1 figures taken from the half-year financial report of that year (statements in section 3; segment note 3 (2023: note 3; 2024: note 4); revenue by metier note 4.1 (2024: 5.1)). Values printed as '-' recorded as 0; '(0)' recorded as 0.

Constant-currency and current-currency growth rates (sector, geo, totals, Q2) taken at one-decimal precision from the H1 results press releases (reports print whole percentages); they agree with the rounded figures in the reports.
Q2/yy entries = second-quarter revenue alone from the 'REVENUE BY GEOGRAPHICAL AREA / SECTOR - 2nd quarter' tables of each H1 press release (cc and current growth vs prior-year Q2).

H1/23 (2023 HY report p.14): the cash flow statement shows D&A in three lines: depreciation of fixed assets 183, amortisation of right-of-use assets 139, impairment losses 22. cf.da / memo.da_cf = 344 is their sum; the H1 2024 report prints 344 as the combined H1 2023 comparative line. From H1/24 onward a single combined line is printed.

memo.da_fixed and memo.da_rou use the totals 'included in operating expenses (Other income and expenses and Cost of sales)' stated under note 4.4/5.4 (H1/23 183/139; H1/24 205/165; H1/25 218/172; H1/26 237/186). The Other-income-and-expenses table alone shows fixed-asset D&A of 155/175/184/201 and ROU amortisation of 137/164/170/184. memo.impairment = impairment losses line in that note (22/12/70/98).
memo.lease_interest = 'Interest expense on lease liabilities' from the net financial income note (8.1; 2024: 9.1).

H1/25 and H1/26: French exceptional contribution on the profits of large companies. Neither the reports nor the press releases print its euro amount, so memo.excep_tax = null. Disclosed: ETR 35.4% in both halves (vs an underlying estimated annual rate of 28.0% for 2025 / 28% for 2026); estimated annual rate including the contribution 33.2% for 2025 and 33% for 2026; the prior-year-based portion was booked in full in H1 (IAS 34). Rough implied amount (not recorded): (35.4% - 28%) x PBT, about EUR 0.25bn each half.

memo.ni_excl_excep = 2500 for H1/25 and H1/26: company-published 'net profit group share excluding the exceptional contribution' printed only as 'EUR 2.5 billion' (rounded) in the 2025/2026 HY reports (2.3.1) and press releases. Also printed: 31.2% of revenue (H1/25) and 30.7% (H1/26). The H1/25 report also says operating cash flows excluding the contribution rose 6% to EUR 3.0bn.
2026 HY report note 1.2: the 2026 Finance Act renewed the exceptional contribution for one more year; rate kept at 41.2% for Hermes.

H1/23 restated net cash reconciliation (2023 HY report note 2.3): cash 9,349 - overdrafts 23 = net cash 9,326; + cash investments >3 months 523 - financial liabilities 1 = 9,848. Borrowings on the balance sheet (58) also include 34 of commitments to buy out minority interests, which are excluded from restated net cash. The same structure applies in later years (put options for NCI 48 / 29 / 4 in H1/24 / H1/25 / H1/26).
apm.bank_overdrafts is recorded as a positive amount (shown as a deduction in the reconciliation); fin_liab_restated is negative as printed ((1), (1), (1), (0)).
H1/26: net cash 12,310 equals cash 12,310 even though overdrafts of (1) are printed. This is a rounding effect in the source.

From the 2025 report on, neither line is shown separately (presumably grouped into other non-current assets, which jump to 183 at H1/25 from 45 at H1/24), so loans_deposits = null for H1/25 and H1/26.

Ordinary dividends: FY2022 13.00 (paid H1/23, 1,359m); FY2025 18.00 (paid H1/26, 1,887m).

Provisional goodwill 164 (goodwill 241 at 30/06/2024 vs 72 at 31/12/2023); acquisitions of consolidated shares (218). Geographic label became 'Other (Middle East)'; Other revenue +105%.

Nonrecurring items: none in any of the four halves (Other non-recurring income and expenses printed as '-').
Interim tax rates: H1/23 estimated annual rate 27.5%; H1/24 28.2% (FY2023 27.8%); H1/25 28.0% excl. contribution (33.2% incl.; ETR 35.4%); H1/26 28% excl. (33% incl.; ETR 35.4%).
